title: The Cloud Run provisioning pipelines that deploy the AI Guard Apigee patterns: what they create, the KVM they write, and the cloud the SharedFlow pipeline leaves at us1

prose.text: The Cloud Run folder automates deploying the two Apigee patterns; it adds no scanning logic of its own. {{pipelines}} {{bundle-copies}} {{bundle-copies-identical}}

prose.label: What gets deployed.
prose.text: The scanning behavior is the inline proxy's ([[ai-security.ai-guard.integrations.google-apigee-proxy]]) or the SharedFlow's ([[ai-security.ai-guard.integrations.google-apigee-sharedflow]]).

pipelines.statement: Each pipeline is Cloud Build building a provisioner image and running it as a Cloud Run Job that enables APIs, creates the Vertex service account and its IAM bindings, writes the encrypted KVM, and imports and deploys the bundles: `flow/` deploys the SharedFlow and the `vertex-aiguard-sync` proxy, `proxy/` the inline `vertex-aiguard` proxy.

| [`proxy/`](proxy) | **Monolithic** — self-contained `vertex-aiguard` proxy with the policies inline |

bundle-copies-identical.statement: At the pin the pipelines' bundle copies are identical to the canonical SharedFlow, `vertex-aiguard-sync` and inline-proxy bundles, so the Apigee subjects describe what the pipelines deploy.
bundle-copies-identical.conditions: Rests on a recursive diff at d6bf200 of flow/bundles/ZSCALER-AIGUARD/sharedflowbundle, flow/bundles/vertex-aiguard-sync and proxy/bundles/vertex-aiguard/apiproxy against their Google/apigee counterparts, which found no differences.

org-not-created.statement: The pipelines configure an existing Apigee X organization and do not create one; the separate `provision_org.py` creates the organization, runtime instance, environment, environment group and both attachments, and the README warns the runtime instance takes 20 to 40 minutes and the region must match any existing API Hub instance.

api-key-secret.statement: The bootstrap script stores the AI Guard key in Secret Manager as `aiguard-api-key` and Cloud Build injects it into the Job; it is not a trigger substitution.

kvm-entries.statement: The SharedFlow pipeline writes only `aiguard_api_key`, plus `aiguard_policy_id` when one is given, to the `aiguard-config` KVM; the inline-proxy pipeline also writes `aiguard_cloud` (substitution `_AIGUARD_CLOUD`, default `us1`), `vertex_project` and `vertex_model`.

quotes: entries = {"aiguard_api_key": api_key}

KVM_NAME = "aiguard-config"

flow-cloud-us1.statement: As deployed by the SharedFlow pipeline, scans go to `api.us1.zseclipse.net`: the pipeline has no cloud setting, the SharedFlow takes the cloud only from an `aiguardCloud` flow variable, and the shipped `vertex-aiguard-sync` proxy sets none, so a tenant on another cloud gets authentication failures, which fail closed, until the calling proxy sets `aiguardCloud`.
flow-cloud-us1.conditions: Rests on a search of the flow pipeline and the vertex-aiguard-sync bundle at the pin, which assign no aiguardCloud; that a key from another cloud is rejected by the us1 API is assumed, not tested.
